Automated translation (refer to source for accuracy)

The Children's Library will close temporarily for facility repairs during the following dates.

We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

【Closure Period (all day)】

December 4, 2026 (Reiwa 8) through January 15, 2027 (Reiwa 9)

【Changes during closure】

• You cannot visit the Children's Library, borrow books, or return books during this period.

• If you have reserved materials scheduled for pickup at the Children's Library, please pick them up at the Main Library instead.

• The book drop box remains available throughout the closure.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-lib.jp/calendar/post-85.html
summary: 📚 Children's Library Temporary Closure (Dec. 4, 2026 – Jan. 15, 2027 Reiwa 9)
